flags.note: The construct שֶׁל + noun for genitive relation (sea of glass) shows possible Greek influence. Native Hebrew would more likely use construct state יַם זְכוּכִית.
The temporal construction 'in the hour that' may reflect Greek ὅταν structures, though this could be natural late Hebrew development.
The phrase 'by the hand of your will' appears to calque Greek διὰ τὸ θέλημά σου. Natural Hebrew would use בִּרְצוֹנְךָ or כִּרְצוֹנְךָ.
